name: terrain-paint-dry-grass
_comment: Terrain material paint (editor Terrain Inspector → MATERIALS), dry open ground: east / south-east plains (24434 cells) and south-facing slopes (20917 cells). Format PENDING the bridge's /import/terrain-paint schema: polygons in CS2 x/z metres (the same at both scales), strength 1. Material name is a PLACEHOLDER until the bridge lists the editor's materials.
